messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — noticed a small quality dip when prefetch is ON for 70B-8bit across multi-turn safety prompts. p@1 down ~2.6% vs baseline. Anyone else seeing this?
Josh: saw the same in yesterday's canary. latency improved ~12% p50 but quality tradeoff is real. :thinking_face:
Raja: rough hypothesis: prefetch/KV staleness + quantization noise interacting for long-context tokens. early tokens confident but later turn reranks fail.
Lin: can you paste the canary config and the eval slice?
Marta: config excerpt: ```json
{"model":"redwood-70b-q8","prefetch":true,"prefetch_window":64,"kv_refresh_ms":1200,"batch_size":8}
```
Marta: eval slice: 1.5k multi-turn safety prompts (avg turn=6), metric=hits@1 on curated gold answers + manual spot-checks.
Sana: how big is the canary sample? hope this isn't just noise.
Marta: canary was ~600 queries production-weighted. not tiny but not conclusive. hence thread.
Raja: test idea — two axes: (A) prefetch window size (32/64/128) (B) kv_refresh_ms (800/1200/2000) with and without q8. run 24h A/B with 2k eval queries.
Josh: agree. also add a short-latency-sensitive slice (single-turn) to confirm perf improvements remain.
Lin: do we have logs showing mismatch in top-k logits over turns? that could indicate drift.
Marta: grabbing logs now. snippet from run: ```
[2026-02-11T11:02:03Z] request_id=abc123 turn=4 top1_token="yes" logit=-0.32 top2_token="no" logit=-1.8
[2026-02-11T11:02:03Z] request_id=abc123 turn=6 top1_token="no" logit=-0.29 top2_token="yes" logit=-1.7
```
Marta: feels like flip-flop in later turns — could be kv cache miss or quant noise amplification.
Sana: add EvalBot check: run perplexity + calibration (expected vs actual token probs) and adversarial safety prompts.
EvalBot: scheduled job queued: eval/run_bindings --model redwood-70b-q8 --dataset multi_turn_safety_2k --slices ["multi_turn","latency_sensitive"] --metrics ["hits@1","ppl","calibration","latency_p50,p95"] --runs 3
Raja: operational checklist: 1) small canary w/ traffic split 90/10 prefetch ON/OFF 2) collect top-5 logits per turn 3) persist kv timestamps to correlate with flips.
Josh: thresholds proposal: reject prefetch variant if hits@1 drop >1.0% absolute OR calibration degradation >0.03 Brier.
Lin: also measure token-level jitter (fraction of turns where top-1 changes after prefetch) — might be a sensitive signal.
Marta: I'll spin up the A/B with 2k eval set and the three kv windows. Will post results in this thread by EOD PST.
Sana: thx. if confirmed, mitigation options: reduce prefetch_window, increase kv_refresh, or fallback to non-prefetch for long conversations.
Raja: for long-term, maybe a quick heuristic: if convo length > 12 turns, force non-prefetch on quantized models. cheap to implement as routing rule.
Josh: +1. also worth trying asymmetric refresh: refresh only when entropy rises above threshold.
Marta: noted. assigning tasks: Marta -> run ABs, Raja -> add kv timestamps metric, Lin -> collect top-5 logits hooks, Sana -> add eval metrics to dashboards.
Sana: will add alert if hits@1 drift >0.5% over 1h during canary.
Marta: thanks all — will dump logs + final numbers here. :thumbsup:
